rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for physical or organizational separation.

example.english: This detachment was carried out to facilitate transport.
example.traditional: 呢次分離係為咗方便運送。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 fan1 lei4 hai6 wai6 zo2 fong1 bin6 wan6 sung3

rows.note: Use this when detachment means showing a cold, unconcerned attitude toward other people.

example.english: Their detachment toward the victims is chilling.
example.traditional: 佢對受害者嘅冷漠態度令人心寒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 sau6 hoi6 ze2 ge3 laang5 mok6 taai3 dou6 ling6 jan4 sam1 hon4

rows.note: Use this for detachment as freedom from personal bias in a judgment or decision.

example.traditional: 評判嘅公正性令大家信服。
example.jyutping: ping4 pun3 ge3 gung1 zing3 sing3 ling6 daai6 gaa1 seon3 fuk6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a military unit detached from its main force for a mission.

example.english: This detachment was ordered to hold the mountain pass.
example.traditional: 呢支分遣隊奉命去守住個山口。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 fan1 hin2 deoi6 fung6 ming6 heoi3 sau2 zyu6 go3 saan1 hau2
